overview: Void-Scar Pass is the primary corridor through Shadow Valley’s deepest fractures.
history: Natural ravines were torn open further by shadow fractures.
Akhevan forces reinforced the pass as a controlled transit route.
Void shards began to suspend in midair, anchored by resonance fields.
Travelers reported reality distortion and temporal echoes within the pass.
During Terror of Luclin, Void-Scar Pass became a critical strategic chokepoint.
hooks: A void shard destabilizes and threatens to collapse part of the pass.
Akhevan escorts move a powerful artifact through the corridor.
Shadow anomalies cluster around a resonance node.
A scout team goes missing while mapping the pass.
